definition_and_source: SEC Central Index Key (submissions API); "NSE:<symbol>" for Indian firms
relevance: Unique firm ID; cluster variable for standard errors
valid_values_and_missing: Never missing

definition_and_source: Exchange ticker (SEC company_tickers.json) or NSE trading symbol
valid_values_and_missing: Blank when the SEC tickers file has no ticker (about 30% of U.S. rows, mostly delisted firms)

definition_and_source: Registrant name (SEC submissions API) or company name (config/india_firms.csv)
valid_values_and_missing: Never missing

definition_and_source: US = SEC registrant; India = NSE-listed comparison firm (config/india_firms.csv)
relevance: Tests whether the post-GenAI shift is common to U.S.-listed and Indian-listed GSIs
valid_values_and_missing: Codes: US, India

definition_and_source: SEC Standard Industrial Classification code (blank for Indian firms)
valid_values_and_missing: 7370, 7371, 7373, 7374 (plus GSIs added by name); blank for Indian firms

definition_and_source: IT consulting & application services (SIC 7370/7371); Systems integration (7373); Data processing & managed services (7374); Indian firms assigned by business description in config/india_firms.csv (adds Engineering & R&D services, used descriptively only)
valid_values_and_missing: Codes as defined; never missing in the panel

definition_and_source: Fiscal quarter-end mapped to calendar quarter
valid_values_and_missing: 2019Q1-2025Q4 (2026 quarters only in panel_extension.csv)

definition_and_source: pre = 2019Q1-2022Q3; transition = 2022Q4; post = 2023Q1-2025Q4
valid_values_and_missing: Codes: pre, transition, post

definition_and_source: 1 if PERIOD = post
valid_values_and_missing: 0 or 1

definition_and_source: U.S.: quarterly revenue from XBRL (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax or Revenues). India: Ind-AS RevenueFromOperations (consolidated, NSE XBRL) divided by the FRED DEXINUS quarterly average INR per USD
valid_values_and_missing: Can be zero or negative in a few derived fourth quarters after restatements (12 U.S. rows); kept as reported

definition_and_source: Natural log of REVENUE_USD
valid_values_and_missing: Blank when REVENUE_USD <= 0

definition_and_source: (Revenue_t - Revenue_t-4) / |Revenue_t-4| x 100, in reporting currency (USD for U.S. firms, INR for Indian firms)
valid_values_and_missing: Blank when the quarter four quarters earlier is missing or not consecutive, or its revenue was below US$1 million or <= 0 (row then dropped); winsorized at 1st/99th percentile within market (U.S. range -69.0 to 249.5)

definition_and_source: REV_GROWTH_YOY in the previous quarter
valid_values_and_missing: Blank when the previous quarter is missing; winsorized as above

definition_and_source: 1 if REV_GROWTH_YOY < 0
valid_values_and_missing: 0 or 1; blank only if growth is blank

definition_and_source: DECLINE_Q in the next quarter (t+1)
valid_values_and_missing: 0 or 1; blank when the next consecutive quarter is not yet reported or missing

definition_and_source: U.S.: OperatingIncomeLoss / revenue x 100. India: (ProfitBeforeTax + FinanceCosts - OtherIncome) / RevenueFromOperations x 100
valid_values_and_missing: Blank when OperatingIncomeLoss is not tagged; winsorized at 1st/99th percentile within market

definition_and_source: SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense / revenue x 100 (U.S. only; Ind-AS statements do not report SG&A)
relevance: Cost structure; dropped from the main RQ2 model and RQ3 features because two-thirds of U.S. rows lack it
valid_values_and_missing: Blank when SG&A is not tagged (about two-thirds of U.S. rows; always blank for India); winsorized; used only in sensitivity checks

definition_and_source: AI keyword matches in the 10-Q/10-K text / total words x 10,000 (U.S. only)
valid_values_and_missing: 0 or more; blank when no 10-Q/10-K for the quarter (and for all Indian rows); winsorized at the 99th percentile

definition_and_source: 1 if any generative-AI-specific term appears in the 10-Q/10-K (U.S. only)
valid_values_and_missing: 0 or 1; blank when AI_INTENSITY is blank

definition_and_source: 1 if the quarter's AI score comes from an annual report (10-K or 10-K/A); 0 if from a 10-Q or 10-Q/A
relevance: Annual reports mention AI about twice as often per 10,000 words, so the 10-K quarter is flagged
valid_values_and_missing: 0 or 1; blank when AI_INTENSITY is blank

definition_and_source: Mean of AI_INTENSITY for the current and three previous consecutive quarters of the same firm
relevance: Smooths the 10-K jump; uses no later information
valid_values_and_missing: Blank unless four consecutive scored quarters exist; winsorized like AI_INTENSITY

definition_and_source: "main" for 2019-2025 rows, "extension" for eligible 2026 rows; only in data/processed/panel_extension.csv
relevance: Keeps the 2026 robustness check separate from the main study
valid_values_and_missing: Codes: main, extension
